description: This PHP source file defines the ConfigurationProvider class for AWS SDK's UseFipsEndpoint module. It provides methods to create configuration providers based on environment variables, INI config files, and fallback logic, with support for caching and composition of multiple providers.

classes.name: ConfigurationProvider
classes.description: Provides static methods to generate configuration providers for AWS FIPS endpoints, supporting environment variables, INI files, and fallback options, with caching and provider chaining.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Creates a default configuration provider that checks environment variables, shared config files, and fallback options, with optional caching.

methods.name: env
methods.description: Creates a configuration provider that reads the AWS_USE_FIPS_ENDPOINT environment variable.

methods.name: ini
methods.description: Creates a configuration provider that reads configuration from an INI file, with optional profile and filename parameters.

methods.name: fallback
methods.description: Creates a fallback configuration provider based on the region, setting FIPS mode accordingly.
